name: North Brazil Current
scope: Northwestward surface North Brazil regional branch from an OSW gate near the source-described 5 S origin to a nominal 7 N retroflection approach. Alternative terminal conventions stop at 5 or 9 N. Excludes upstream North Brazil Undercurrent, offshore retroflected return branch, NECC/EUC continuations, Guiana continuation and detached ring tracks or perimeters. No whole circulation-system length asserted.
layer: Surface/upper-layer regional geography after the upstream undercurrent surfaces; no fixed-depth core or velocity contour extracted.
time_convention: Regional surface naming and retroflection gate conventions; not a dated axis, annual average or model-derived seasonal length distribution.
source_locator: Section 1: surface origin near 5 S, NBUC surfacing near 5-6 S, retroflection region 5-9 N / 45-50 W and named Guyana continuation north of 10 N.
source_citation: Dimoune et al. (2023), Revisiting the tropical Atlantic western boundary circulation from a 25-year time series of satellite altimetry data, Ocean Science 19, 251-268, doi:10.5194/os-19-251-2023.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects all longitudes and route vertices. Start latitude uses the source surface-origin convention; 5/7/9 N terminal gates sample the source retroflection region. Offshore departure position and curve are not traced from altimetry. NOAA describes a wider 4-10 N retroflection range, outside this finite scenario set.
scenario_rule: Three terminal-region conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets: 81 editorial scenarios; not statistical uncertainty or all observed retroflections.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Earlier 5 N regional departure convention; no offshore return branch included.
Later 9 N offshore approach convention; not continuation to Caribbean.

supporting_sources.locator: Overview: northeast Brazil boundary current and retroflection between 4 and 10 N; separate northwestward rings.
supporting_sources.role: Broader endpoint variability context; rings are not added to route length.
